svg.title: Predicted and true planes
svg.desc: Isometric evaluation view of known query and predicted plane poses. Blue marks true query geometry; orange marks predicted MRI geometry. Lines connect corresponding centers. Plane glyphs are 10 by 10 millimetres.

g.text: Isometric projection of RAS coordinates; known geometry for evaluation only.
Plane glyphs are 10 × 10 mm for visibility; image fields of view are not depicted.
Normal angle ignores normal sign (0 to 90°); in-plane rotation is not scored.
Geometry visualization only. It does not establish registration quality or infer a pose.
